old_caption: The video features a healthcare professional, likely a nurse or doctor, dressed in blue scrubs and a disposable surgical cap. The individual is seen adjusting a white surgical mask on their face, lifting it slightly away from the nose and mouth. The background is a plain, light-colored wall, which keeps the focus on the subject. The person's hands are actively engaged in adjusting the mask, demonstrating proper technique for handling personal protective equipment (PPE). The lighting is even and bright, highlighting the details of the scrubs and the mask. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent medium shot that captures the upper body of the individual. The video emphasizes the importance of proper PPE use in healthcare settings.
original_wisa_caption: The video features a healthcare professional, likely a nurse or doctor, dressed in blue scrubs and a disposable surgical cap. The individual is seen adjusting a white surgical mask over their face, ensuring it fits snugly around the nose and mouth. The background is a plain, light-colored wall, which keeps the focus on the subject. The person's hands are actively engaged in securing the mask, demonstrating proper technique for wearing personal protective equipment (PPE). The lighting is even and bright, highlighting the details of the scrubs and the mask. There are no other objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera remains stationary throughout the sequence, maintaining a consistent medium shot that captures the upper body of the individual. The video emphasizes the importance of proper PPE use in healthcare settings.
caption: A person in blue scrubs, a pale-blue bouffant cap, and clear safety glasses stands centered against a plain light-gray backdrop, a white pleated surgical mask covering the lower face. One hand is already raised to the mask, fingers resting against the upper edge near the nose and the side over the mouth, pressing the material as though fitting it. Small wrist and fingertip shifts keep the hand in contact through the early portion of the clip. Around the middle the hand releases the fabric and travels downward, sweeping past the chin and neck with motion blur before leaving the frame. The mask then remains seated over the nose and mouth, its top edge tucked beneath the glasses and its bottom edge over the chin. For the rest of the excerpt the subject holds a steady forward gaze, with only faint head and eye micro-movements. The framing and background stay constant throughout.

An internal editing cut is not evidence of physical motion connecting the views.

a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.
Compare several frames before asserting translation, rotation, direction, unchanged position or
camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.
Remove invented scene details and explanations, but keep clearly visible ongoing motion and
processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

Retain the WISA English narrative style, detail density and paragraph structure. Aim for the
provided original word count within 85%-115%, using genuinely visible details and process.

Complete every sentence. If accuracy requires a substantial length difference, explain it outside
